description: This file contains utility functions for managing environment PATH variables and locating the 'openclaw' executable, including platform-specific and environment-based path adjustments.

methods.name: isExecutable
methods.description: Checks if a given file path is executable.

methods.name: isDirectory
methods.description: Checks if a given directory path exists and is a directory.

methods.name: mergePath
methods.description: Merges existing PATH with prepend and append directories, removing duplicates.

methods.name: candidateBinDirs
methods.description: Determines candidate directories for the 'openclaw' executable based on environment, platform, and configuration.

methods.name: ensureOpenClawCliOnPath
methods.description: Sets up the PATH environment variable to include directories where 'openclaw' might be located, ensuring it is accessible.
